Method of Attack: Malicious JavaScript file that accesses ungoverned mobile sensors (accelerometer, gyroscope, proximity, NFC, rotation sensors) without OS permission restrictions to collect sensor data and infer user PINs or passwords
Logs sensor usage data and sends it to attacker's server
Continues to collect data when running in background
Uses artificial neural network to guess PINs with high accuracy
Discoverer: Research team from the University of Newcastle, UK, including Dr. Siamak Shahandashti
Impacted Systems: Mobile devices with sensors such as accelerometer, gyroscope, proximity, NFC, rotation sensors
Mobile operating systems that do not restrict sensor access (e.g., Android, iOS before mitigations)
Attack Vector: Malicious JavaScript code loaded secretly on websites or mobile apps, running in browser or tainted apps
Indicators of Compromise: Sensor data logging from motion and orientation sensors
